title: Create Costing for a Person
goal: Add costing to the right assignment for one employee in Oracle, from the right effective date, with the right Chart of Accounts string.
context: Screen steps are taken from the HCM job aid 'Create Costing for Persons in Oracle Cloud' (last updated 8/4/26). DRAFT FOR SME REVIEW: the 'have the details ready' checkpoint, the hints and the follow-up reminder describe sensible practice but are not from a published SOP. Confirm them and the contacts with the HCM Academy team.

steps.title: Have the costing details ready
steps.instruction: Before you start, make sure you know which employee and which assignment this is for, the effective date, the percentage, and the Chart of Accounts (COA) string.
steps.why: Costing is approved automatically as soon as you submit, so there is no one to catch a wrong string afterwards. If any detail is missing, ask before you go on.
steps.confirm: I have the employee, assignment, date, percentage and COA string

steps.title: Search for the employee
steps.instruction: From the Oracle Home page, search for the employee.
steps.where: The search bar on the Home page.
steps.expect: The employee appears in the search results.
hints: Another way in: go to the Our Workforce tab, choose Costing for Persons from Quick Actions, then search for the employee there (or use Advanced Search). Then skip the next step.

steps.title: Open Costing for Persons
steps.instruction: Select the drop-down arrow next to the employee's name, then choose Costing for Persons.
steps.where: Next to the employee's name in the search results.
steps.expect: The Costing for a Person Overview page opens for that employee.

steps.title: Find the assignment
steps.instruction: Under Costing for a Person Overview, find the list of assignments.
steps.where: The assignments list on the Costing for a Person Overview page.
steps.expect: You can see the employee's assignments.
hints: If the employee has more than one assignment, check the assignment number or job title against what you were given before you choose.

steps.title: Select the assignment
steps.instruction: Select the specific assignment you need to add costing to.

steps.title: Choose Create Costing
steps.instruction: Open the Actions drop-down, choose Create, then choose Create Costing.
steps.where: The Actions drop-down on the overview page.
steps.expect: The page to enter costing information opens.

steps.title: Enter the effective date
steps.expect: The date shown is the date the costing should start.
steps.why: Payroll charges the new accounts from this date.

steps.title: Enter the percentage
steps.instruction: Enter the Percentage. Use 100 unless you were told otherwise.
steps.expect: The Percentage field shows the right amount.

steps.title: Enter the COA string
steps.instruction: Enter the correct Chart of Accounts (COA) string for the assignment.
steps.expect: The full COA string is entered.
steps.why: The COA string decides which accounts this person's pay is charged to.
hints: Copy the string from where you were given it rather than typing it from memory, then read it back segment by segment.

steps.title: Review before you submit
steps.instruction: Review the costing information for accuracy: the assignment, the effective date, the percentage and the COA string.
steps.why: Oracle approves costing automatically once you submit. This is your last check.
steps.confirm: Everything matches what I was given

steps.title: Submit
steps.where: At the top of the page.
steps.expect: Oracle confirms the costing was submitted.

callouts.say: Percentage is 100% unless you were directed otherwise.
callouts.source: Create Costing for Persons in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 8/4/26

callouts.say: Changes to costing are approved automatically by Oracle after you submit.
callouts.source: Create Costing for Persons in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 8/4/26

reminders.say: Open Costing for Persons for the employee again and check the new costing shows on the right assignment from the effective date.

recap.summary: You added costing to one employee's assignment, from the right effective date, with the percentage and COA string checked before submitting.
nextSteps: Check the costing shows on the assignment in Costing for Persons.
If something is wrong, use Update Costing for Persons rather than creating it again.
